scope: move the forged acknowledgement into the forward loop so it leaves from the same socket

implementation.helper: forge_ack_packet(seq, ack_override, qport_override): locates the dedrun's AdministraClient client_t, encodes plain = u32 ack + 00 00 with forge_client_ack.encode, and prefixes seq + qport
implementation.socket: forward now binds 127.0.0.1:0 explicitly and passes its own port as qport, so the ack leaves from the endpoint the dedrun already knows
implementation.verification: an isolated call produced packet_hex 0700000022c8137878787878 with qport 51234, proving the override is applied

analysis.implementation_works: the forward loop emits forge attempts every 0.8 s from its own socket, and the packet builder was verified independently
analysis.why_no_ack_landed: by the time this forward started, the client had already been timed out and the dedrun had moved it to CS_ZOMBIE, so find_name no longer finds AdministraClient and no packet can be built
analysis.lesson: the forged acknowledgement must begin as soon as the client_t exists (right after the connect/challenge exchange), not minutes later
